books.title: The Mysterious Island

books.summary: Five Americans, balloon-wrecked on a deserted island, must find a way to survive while revealing the island’s strange mysteries.

books.title: Pirates of Venus
books.author: Edgar Rice Burroughs
books.summary: A space traveler accidentally finds himself on Venus and must learn the local customs to survive.

books.title: An Autobiography
books.author: Theodore Roosevelt
books.summary: The autobiography of American President Theodore Roosevelt.

books.title: Queen Victoria
books.author: Lytton Strachey
books.summary: A sardonic and generally unflattering biography of Victoria Alexandrina, Queen of England.

books.title: Catriona
books.author: Robert Louis Stevenson
books.summary: After coming into his fortune and evading his uncle’s schemes, young gentleman David Balfour continues his adventures in 18th century Scotland, helping a politically unwelcome friend escape into France, avoiding the hangman himself, finding his place as a gentleman in Edinburgh society, and falling in love with the daughter of a notorious Macgregor clansman.

books.title: The Adventures of Sally
books.author: P. G. Wodehouse
books.summary: A young woman comes into an inheritance, loses it all, and finds love along the way.

books.title: Man and Superman
books.author: George Bernard Shaw
books.summary: Jack Tanner flees both London and responsibility when he is made guardian of his childhood friend Ann Whitehead.

books.title: The Portent
books.author: George MacDonald
books.summary: A young Scottish tutor, gifted with a supernatural sense, discovers a haunting connection to a somnambulant noblewoman while residing at a remote English estate.

books.title: Brigadier Gerard Stories
books.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
books.summary: A gallant French cavalryman recounts his adventures in the Napoleonic Wars.

books.title: Short Fiction
books.author: H. P. Lovecraft
books.summary: The complete U.S. public domain short fiction of horror legend H. P. Lovecraft.

books.title: Roughing It
books.author: Mark Twain
books.summary: Mark Twain’s semiautobiographical account of his travel across the United States.

books.title: Whose Body?
books.author: Dorothy L. Sayers
books.summary: An aristocratic detective unravels the mystery of a body deposited in a bathtub in 1920s England.

books.title: My First Summer in the Sierra
books.author: John Muir
books.summary: The influential Scottish-American naturalist spends a summer exploring the high country surrounding the headwaters of the Merced and Tuolumne rivers in the Sierra Nevada, and records what he sees in a diary.

books.title: Reflections on the Revolution in France
books.author: Edmund Burke
books.summary: The conservative political theorist Edmund Burke critiques the political program of the French Revolution.

books.title: Poetry

books.summary: A collection of poetry by Scottish author, poet, and Christian minister George MacDonald, exploring themes of faith, nature, redemption, and the human soul.

books.title: Krakatit

books.summary: An engineer invents a terrible new explosive that becomes of interest to the authorities.

books.title: The Inheritors
books.author: Joseph Conrad
books.summary: A young writer dabbling in journalism meets a strange, otherworldly woman with long-term political goals.

books.title: Short Fiction
books.author: Mack Reynolds
books.summary: A collection of science fiction short stories by Mack Reynolds ordered by date of publication.

books.title: A Day at a Time
books.author: Archibald Alexander
books.summary: A 1916 Christian devotional reflecting on faith and morality during World War I.

books.title: On a Chinese Screen
books.author: W. Somerset Maugham
